Messages.Author: DJ.Mik
Messages.Body:
Well, this question is pretty obvious !!

Marconius plays Basilisk Touch [SUP] before range is chosen, his
opponent goes to long & Marconius strikes w. Shadow Strike.

Will Marc.'s opponent go to torpor if the Shadow Strike is succesfully
inflicted ?

(I know that strikes based on strength are always considered hand
strikes, but is Shadow Strike an exception ??)

Thanx for answering !!

DJ Mik

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
DJ.Mik wrote:
> Well, this question is pretty obvious !!
>
> Marconius plays Basilisk Touch [SUP] before range is chosen, his
> opponent goes to long & Marconius strikes w. Shadow Strike.
>
> Will Marc.'s opponent go to torpor if the Shadow Strike is succesfully
> inflicted ?

No. He has to make a hand strike in order to "trigger" the Basilisk's
Touch's effect. (card text).

> (I know that strikes based on strength are always considered hand
> strikes, but is Shadow Strike an exception ??)

Strikes based on strength are no always considered hand strikes.
For example: Bastard Sword, Sengir Dagger, Kraken's Kiss.

A hand strike is a non-ranged, non-weapon strike that inflicts damage
based on the striking minion's strength.

Shadow Strike is ranged, so it isn't a hand strike. Therefore, no
exception to the definition is needed.
